name: docs
description: Maintain project documentation: /audit-docs verifies CLAUDE.md, READMEs, .claude/commands, .claude/skills, .claude/rules, and architecture docs for stale claims about the codebase; /enrich-claude-md investigates the codebase for useful, non-obvious facts missing from CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules and proposes additions, including suggesting a new nested CLAUDE.md for subtree-specific facts. Both report findings and offer to apply fixes per finding
